name.es: Polea GT2 de 20 dientes, barreno de 5 mm
name.fr: Poulie GT2 20 dents, alésage de 5 mm
name.pt: Polia GT2 de 20 dentes, furo de 5 mm

description.en: A 2 mm-pitch GT2 timing pulley with 20 teeth for a 6 mm belt, a 5 mm bore and set screws. It mates a Ø5 mm motor shaft by its bore.
description.es: Una polea dentada GT2 de 2 mm de paso con 20 dientes para banda de 6 mm, barreno de 5 mm y opresores. Se une por su barreno a una flecha de motor de Ø5 mm.
description.fr: Une poulie crantée GT2 au pas de 2 mm à 20 dents pour courroie de 6 mm, alésage de 5 mm et vis de pression. Elle s'accouple par son alésage à un arbre moteur de Ø5 mm.
description.pt: Uma polia dentada GT2 de passo 2 mm com 20 dentes para correia de 6 mm, furo de 5 mm e parafusos de fixação. Acopla pelo furo a um eixo de motor de Ø5 mm.

governing.designation: GT2 20-tooth pulley, 5 mm bore, 6 mm belt (Adafruit 1251)

sources.title: Adafruit product 1251 — aluminum GT2 timing pulley, 6 mm belt, 20 tooth, 5 mm bore
sources.supports: length 16 mm, outer (flange) diameter 16 mm, geared section 12.2 mm, 5 mm bore, 6 mm belt, 20 teeth, 2 set screws, 6 g

sources.title: ServoCity 2 mm pitch GT2 pinion timing pulley (5 mm bore, 20 tooth)
sources.supports: 2 mm GT2 pitch, 20 teeth, 5 mm bore, 6 mm belt

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of end face A (the end that faces the motor when mounted), on the bore axis. +z runs along the bore away from the motor, to end face B at z = 16. +x is an arbitrary radial reference.

interfaces.note: The bore carries the size key of the shaft it fits (equal size keys are the mating rule): this 5 mm bore fits the NEMA 17 Ø5 shaft. Female: it receives the shaft.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P4-STD lane, 2026-10-02); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: The belt engagement is not an interface in v1: the belt is not a catalog part, and neither cited source states where the toothed section sits along the pulley. The catalog key equals the interface-sizes key gt2-pulley-20t-5mm, which describes the pulley as a whole.
